contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

The sherd is a base fragment of an unknown vessel. The sherd is made from Samian Ware, suggesting the vessel is a table vessel, rather than for utilitarian purposes. Samian Ware was imported into Britain from the mid 1st to mid 3rd century (Webster, P. 1996 ‘Roman Samian Pottery in Britain’ CBA Practical Handbook 13).
